fact: Minister of Justice Nelson Ramaotwana told Parliament in the 2026/27 budget debate that the Industrial Court had developed an electronic Case Management System to digitise operations, with a soft launch planned within Q1 2026/27 after procurement of necessary software.
system: Industrial Court electronic Case Management System

fact: The Botswana Gazette reports the Ministry of Justice and Correctional Services told the Committee of Supply in March 2026 that the Case Management System, designed for case registration and status checks, had not been operational due to system errors.

Chief Registrar Beaulah Mguni told the Public Accounts Committee that the Court Record Management System is outdated and obsolete except in Gaborone, and that the department is procuring a service provider to expand it and to build the e-filing component, which is not operational.
